title: No sticking!  The lid is a nice addition!
text: No sticking!  The lid is a nice addition!. These are great!  I made cake and brownies in these pans and they didn't stick!  They cooked well and even. The cake and brownies both came out of the pan with easy.  I was able to flip the cake out without it splitting or sticking. I love the lid.  It made it easy to store the left over brownies and cake.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Recipe Right Non-Stick 13 x 9-Inch Covered Oblong Baking Pan with Lid, Pack of 2
features: Baking pans measure 13 x 9 x 2 inches each; perfect addition to any baking set or baking supplies
Steel cake pans have non-stick coating for easy release and quick cleanup; lids made of plastic
Ideal as a brownie pan, cake pan, casserole dish with lid, cookie sheet, pizza pan or bread pan
The Wilton Recipe Right non-stick cake pan bakeware sets come with a limited lifetime warranty
Dishwasher safe; however for best results, wash baking sheet in warm, soapy water after each use
description: These are the pans you need when it's got to be taken on the go. Bake brownies, bar cookies, casseroles and more, add the covers, then bring them to a picnic, party or family gathering. The deep clear covers won't Smash whatever food is inside, even if you've got cupcakes swirled with icing.
